description: Erection of outbuilding to rear garden for use as an annexe.
decision_conditions: The proposed outbuilding, by virtue of the excessive height, bulk and scale, does not result in a subordinate and proportionate addition to the main dwelling, and  would cause harm to the character and appearance of the application property and to the character and appearance of the surrounding area. The proposal thereby fails to comply with Policy BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One - Strategic Policies (November 2012) and Policies DMHB 11, DMHB 12 and DMHD 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (January 2020); and Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021.

The proposal would create an independent, self-contained residential unit in a position where such a dwelling would be unacceptable. It would harm the character and appearance of the area, fail to provide acceptable living conditions for occupants of the outbuilding, and harm the amenity of neighbouring occupants/residents. The proposal is, therefore, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D1; D3 and D6 of the London Plan (2021),  Policy BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One - Strategic Policies (2012) and Policies DMHD 2;  DMHB 11; DMHB12; DMHB16 and DMHB18 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020).

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from the  Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service.

We have however been unable to seek solutions to problems arising from the application as the principal of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
